FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At FloorCraft Solutions, we specialize in the professional installation of a wide range of floor coverings, including carpet, hardwood, laminate, and vinyl flooring, primarily serving residential customers. Our operations focus on providing quality craftsmanship and exceptional customer service through our skilled team of installers. Each member is trained in the latest installation techniques and adheres to comprehensive safety protocols to ensure a safe work environment.

We prioritize the use of non-toxic, pre-manufactured flooring materials sourced from reputable suppliers, ensuring that our products meet high safety standards. Additionally, we maintain all necessary licenses and permits, and our business is fully compliant with all regulations, including workers’ compensation for our employees. Our business operations adhere to industry best practices and maintain a focus on safety and quality.

Our installation process includes thorough pre-installation assessments and post-installation inspections, which involve obtaining customer sign-off to ensure satisfaction with the completed work. We also utilize secure digital scheduling and invoicing systems to streamline operations and enhance customer experience. Overall, our focus is on delivering high-quality flooring solutions while maintaining strict adherence to safety and regulatory standards.
